mito -use http,collections -log_requests src.cel
stderr 'transaction\.id'
cmp stdout want.txt

-- src.cel --

	"Header.Accept-Ranges",
	"Header.Age",
	"Header.Date",
	"Header.Etag",
	"Header.Cache-Control",
	"Header.Last-Modified",
	"Header.X-Cache",
	"Header.Expires",
	"Header.Server",
])
